run_train_model: run the training pipeline with a Hydra config to train a PyTorch Lightning model
run_eval_model: run evaluation on a trained PyTorch Lightning model using a Hydra config
run_train_test: run the training pipeline in train mode then evaluate on the test set
run_eval_checkpoint: run evaluation with a Lightning or PyTorch checkpoint on val and test splits
run_print_config: run the script with print_config enabled to pretty-print the Hydra DictConfig
